facts.text: Manhattan Beach was incorporated in June 1941, establishing a formal municipal government after decades of informal settlement.
The Manhattan Beach Historical Society, founded as the City Historical Committee in 1970, became a non‑profit on Oct. 20 1977.
Its museum, housed in Polliwog Park, showcases artifacts that chronicle the town’s early 20th‑century fishing and logging heritage.
Located along County Road 1 near County Road 66, Manhattan Beach sits just north of Crosslake in Crow Wing County.
Every summer, the town hosts a 6‑Man Beach Volleyball Tournament, drawing teams from across the region for a friendly competition.
Concerts in the Park, a weekly summer series, features local acts such as Jimmy’s Buffet and Cobra Cowboy, adding a musical flavor to evenings.
